annotations.title: Search rank summary for a keyword

description: For a searched keyword (e.g. "protein bar"), shows per platform and city which brands led the shelf (store coverage, best rank, sponsored slots), how many stores showed an ad, results depth and price spread. Cached data.

city.description: Optional. One of: Bengaluru, Delhi NCR.

keyword.description: Required. One of: baby lotion, baby wash, baby wipes, coffee powder, cold brew coffee, energy bar, granola bar, instant coffee, protein bar.

platform.description: Optional. One of: Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto.
